name: Nexo Brain
description: Cognitive co-operator that gives AI agents persistent memory, learning, and work continuity. Includes session management, episodic/semantic memory (Atkinson-Shiffrin model), overnight learning (Deep Sleep), autonomous processes, trust scoring, adaptive calibration, unified diagnostics, and a web dashboard. Turns a stateless LLM into an operational partner that remembers, learns from mistakes, and improves over time.
longDescription:
Ships **7 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Hooks** (7): `SessionStart`, `Stop`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `Notification`, `SubagentStop`
- **MCP servers** (1): `nexo`

Installs with `claude plugin install nexo-brain@claude-community` from `wazionapps/nexo`.
